pages.title: Craft a Screen
pages.text: Craft a Screen using four iron ingots, four glass blocks and one amethyst shard.$(br2)Place adjacent screen blocks in a rectangle to make a larger display.

pages.title: Open the Screen
pages.text: Right-click the display to open its interface.$(br2)Gallery shows saved images; its + button imports more. Playlists builds slideshows.

pages.title: Open the Screen
pages.text: Settings controls links, proportions and access.$(br2)A newly placed player display belongs to its placer.
